description: This file implements the core logic for a scientific calculator engine, including operator precedence, command processing, display management, and mathematical functions. It handles user input, operator precedence, unary and binary operations, and display updates within a calculator application.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main class managing calculator operations, command processing, display updates, and mathematical computations.

methods.name: NPrecedenceOfOp
methods.description: Returns a precedence level for a given operator code, higher value indicates higher precedence.

methods.name: HandleErrorCommand
methods.description: Handles invalid input commands by resetting state or ignoring commands.

methods.name: HandleMaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Notifies display that maximum digit limit has been reached.

methods.name: ClearTemporaryValues
methods.description: Resets temporary calculator states such as inverse mode, input buffer, and error flags.

methods.name: ClearDisplay
methods.description: Resets the calculator display to an empty expression.

methods.name: ProcessCommand
methods.description: Main entry point for processing user commands and input codes.

methods.name: ProcessCommandWorker
methods.description: Handles detailed command processing, including operator handling, input interpretation, and state management.

methods.name: ResolveHighestPrecedenceOperation
methods.description: Resolves the top operation on the precedence stack, updating current value and display.

methods.name: CheckAndAddLastBinOpToHistory
methods.description: Manages history of binary operations, including adding or removing last operand/operator.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator's primary display area with new text.

methods.name: DisplayAnnounceBinaryOperator
methods.description: Notifies display that a binary operator has been received.

methods.name: OpCodeToUnaryString
methods.description: Converts an operator code to its unary string representation, considering inversion and angle type.

methods.name: OpCodeToBinaryString
methods.description: Converts an operator code to its binary string representation, considering integer mode.

methods.name: IsCurrentTooBigForTrig
methods.description: Checks if the current value exceeds the maximum allowed for trigonometric functions.

methods.name: GetCurrentRadix
methods.description: Returns the current number base (radix) used in calculations.

methods.name: GetCurrentResultForRadix
methods.description: Returns the current calculation result formatted for a specific radix and precision, optionally grouping digits.

methods.name: GetStringForDisplay
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a Rational number for display, considering mode and radix.

methods.name: GenerateRandomNumber
methods.description: Produces a random floating-point number between 0 and 1 using a Mersenne Twister engine.
